About FAST Lahore

FAST NUCES Lahore Campus

The Lahore Campus, spread over 12.5 acres, is located in Faisal Town which is the heart of greater Lahore. The campus consists of three blocks with classrooms and laboratories for computing and engineering students.

In addition to the University-sponsored financial assistance and scholarships, Lahore Campus also receives scholarships for 10 meritorious students.
